title: LED Experiments: Making Holiday Lights Less Garish
summary: Technology Connections experiments with filtering white and colored LEDs to make holiday lights look less garish. He explains why narrowband LED strings look harsh compared with incandescent bulbs.
why: HN links it in any LED Christmas light discussion as the explanation of why they look off and how to fix it.
